reason: I grab my Monster at the petrol station or Albert on the way, and this isn't there. It's only on an e-shop or in cafés I don't go to, and 55 CZK is more than what I already pay for something I know works.
objection: It's unsweetened yerba mate, so I expect it to taste bitter or like grass tea, and I'm not paying 55 crowns plus delivery to find out.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at Albert or Tesco next to Red Bull for about 40 CZK, or getting a free can to try, so I know it actually tastes good.
